entries.subject: SDSS DR9 colour HiPS
entries.finding: A 3000 x 3000 px hips2fits cutout of CDS/P/SDSS9/color, 12 arcmin wide. The ring and the bar are not saturated. Shallow: the outer arms are faint.

entries.subject: Observatory press images of M95
entries.finding: ESO potw1935a is a 1 arcmin view of the centre. NOIRLab noao-m95 is a 1600 x 2100 px collage whose page gives no coordinates or field.
entries.revisitWhen: A whole-disc photograph is published under an attribution licence.

entries.subject: LEGUS star cluster catalogue of NGC 3351
entries.finding: The Hubble LEGUS programme publishes a star cluster catalogue for NGC 3351 on MAST. It is not on CDS, so it needs its own restore route; not drawn here.
entries.revisitWhen: Star clusters are wanted as a fourth kind of dot.
